articles.title: Iran SHUTS DOOR On Asim Munir's 'Nuclear Proposal'; IRGC's Rezaei's 'Cold' Embrace Goes Viral
articles.description: Pakistan’s most powerful man flew to Tehran with a special delivery from Donald Trump. The parcel contained a US proposal: nuclear inspections, access to around six billion dollars in restricted Iranian funds and possible financial relief. Iran’s response was less “welcome to Tehran” and more “please take this message back.” Mohsen Rezaei reportedly made the red line clear: not one particle of enriched uranium will leave Iran. Munir’s greeting looked formal and chilly. A Qatari delegation reportedly followed and left without a breakthrough. Oil prices briefly celebrated the rumour of a deal. Then Iran rejected the core demand. Pakistan wanted to be the diplomatic bridge. Instead, Munir looked like a postman whose delivery was refused at the door.

articles.title: Weapon Trail: Delhi Police Arrest Four Over Alleged Gun Supply Conspiracy
articles.description: Delhi Police’s Special Cell has reportedly arrested four more accused in connection with the alleged conspiracy to supply weapons to the shooters involved in the firing incident targeting actor Tiger Shroff’s car. The accused have been identified as Kunal and Sumit from Sonipat, Haryana, and Radha and Babita from Uttar Pradesh. According to police sources, the two women allegedly transported the weapons from Delhi to Mumbai by train. Investigators reportedly believe that Kunal was in contact with Anil Pandit, who is alleged to be associated with the Lawrence gang. On his instructions, a pistol and 20 cartridges were allegedly brought from Amritsar. Kunal is accused of arranging for Radha and Babita to transport the weapons to Mumbai, where the bag was reportedly handed over to a minor for further delivery. According to the reported timeline, the women travelled to Mumbai on October 15, arrived on October 17, and allegedly returned to Delhi on October 18, the day of the firing. They were arrested at New Delhi railway station on October 20, while Kunal and Sumit were apprehended in Sonipat. Delhi Police subsequently handed all four accused over to Mumbai Police. A court has reportedly granted three days of transit remand. The allegations remain subject to investigation.

articles.title: Salman Target: Tiger Shroff Firing Case Takes a New Turn as Salman Khan Emerges in Suspect Probe
articles.description: A major new angle has reportedly emerged in the firing case involving Bollywood actor Tiger Shroff’s car. According to sources cited in the report, the arrested suspects may have initially targeted actor Salman Khan, and all three allegedly conducted reconnaissance near his residence. The report claims they turned back after seeing a heavy police deployment outside the actor’s home. Investigators are now questioning the arrested suspects to establish the alleged conspiracy and identify the mastermind behind the attacks. These claims remain subject to police investigation. Following the incident involving Tiger Shroff, security around Salman Khan has reportedly been strengthened further. Bulletproof glass has been installed beside the balcony window at his residence where an earlier firing incident took place, with the installation reportedly completed the previous day. Armed police personnel wearing bulletproof jackets have also been deployed around the actor. In addition, two new police posts have reportedly been established outside his residence. Security arrangements have been reinforced along the boundary, and the number of advanced AI-enabled surveillance cameras has been increased. The developments highlight heightened security concerns surrounding prominent Bollywood personalities as investigators examine whether the separate incidents are connected.
